title: rosa × grovesii
intro: Rosa × grovesii, commonly known as the Sweet Briar or Rosa mundi, is a hybrid rose plant that is known for its fragrant flowers and delicate appearance. The health benefits of Rosa × grovesii include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, anxiety, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Rosa × grovesii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
